items.exampleEn: Not many families took trips abroad during the last recession.
items.exampleZh: 上次經濟衰退期間，出國旅遊的家庭變少了。

items.exampleEn: Her cooking videos became very influential among young parents in Asia.
items.exampleZh: 她的料理影片在亞洲的年輕父母之間變得很有影響力。

items.exampleEn: The team trip had a beneficial effect on everyone's mood.
items.exampleZh: 這趟團隊旅行對每個人的心情都有好處。

items.exampleEn: Advancements in technology have made solar power much cheaper.
items.exampleZh: 科技的進步讓太陽能便宜了很多。

items.exampleEn: No extra fees will be incurred if you cancel before Friday.
items.exampleZh: 如果你在星期五前取消，就不會產生額外費用。

items.exampleEn: Housework was revolutionized by the invention of the washing machine.
items.exampleZh: 家務因為洗衣機的發明而徹底改變。

items.exampleEn: Several factors can affect how well a plant grows.
items.exampleZh: 有好幾個因素會影響植物長得好不好。

items.exampleEn: The school is planning a reform of its exam system.
items.exampleZh: 學校正在規劃考試制度的改革。

items.exampleEn: Many sea birds are threatened by plastic waste in the ocean.
items.exampleZh: 許多海鳥受到海洋中塑膠垃圾的威脅。

items.sentenceEn: Some experts believe a recession may come next year.
items.sentenceZh: 有些專家認為明年可能會出現經濟衰退。

items.audioEn: Walking to work is beneficial: it saves money and keeps you active.
items.audioZh: 走路上班有好處：既省錢又能讓你保持活動。
items.questionZh: 說話者認為走路上班有什麼好處？
options: It is faster than driving a car to work
It saves money and keeps you active
It is safer than the bus
It helps you meet new people on the way

items.sentenceEn: Weather is a big factor in how many visitors we get.
items.sentenceZh: 天氣是影響我們訪客人數的一大因素。

items.sentenceEn: The company incurred large costs when it moved offices.
items.sentenceZh: 公司搬辦公室時承擔了一大筆費用。

items.stemEn: The new park has been ____ to the whole neighborhood.
items.stemZh: 這座新公園對附近一帶都很有益處。

items.stemEn: Experts say the new phone will ____ the way people take photos.
items.stemZh: 專家說這支新手機將徹底改變人們拍照的方式。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, the photo shop on our street was in trouble. A recession had hit the town, and the advent of phone cameras threatened to put the shop out of business. The owner, Mr. Tsai, knew that something had to change. He studied which factors mattered most to his customers and found that many wanted printed photo books as gifts. He made a series of reforms: he trained his staff in design and bought a new printer, although this meant he incurred a large debt. The change was beneficial. Today his shop is one of the most influential in the area, and young designers see working there as a step toward career advancement. His story shows how one idea can revolutionize a small business.
items.passageZh: 十年前，我們這條街上的照相館陷入困境。經濟衰退衝擊了小鎮，手機相機的出現也威脅到照相館的生存。老闆蔡先生知道必須做出改變。他研究哪些因素對顧客最重要，發現很多人想要印好的相簿當禮物。他推動了一連串改革：訓練員工學設計，並買了一台新印表機，雖然這讓他背了一大筆債。這個改變帶來了好處。如今他的店是這一帶最有影響力的照相館之一，年輕設計師也把在那裡工作視為職涯進步的一步。他的故事說明，一個點子就能徹底改變一家小店。

questions.questionZh: 蔡先生發現很多顧客想要什麼？
options: 當天就能拿到的修圖服務

questions.questionZh: 這些改革讓蔡先生付出了什麼代價？

items.promptZh: 這個交換計畫對兩所學校都有好處。
referenceEn: The exchange program was beneficial to both schools.
This exchange program has been beneficial for both schools.
rubricZh: beneficial 表示「有益的、有利的」，後面接 to 或 for（例如 beneficial to both schools 等）
時態可用現在式、過去式或現在完成式（例如 is、was、has been 等）
「交換計畫」可寫，例如 exchange program、exchange programme 等

items.promptZh: 他威脅說，如果公司不幫他加薪，他就會辭職。
referenceEn: He threatened to quit if the company did not raise his pay.
He threatened to leave the company unless he got a pay rise.
rubricZh: threaten 常用 threaten to＋動詞（例如 threatened to quit 等）
「辭職」可寫，例如 quit、leave the company、resign 等
「加薪」可寫，例如 raise his pay、give him a pay rise、a raise 等；時態可用過去式或現在完成式
